text: The SDMP is the first state-wide, multi-hazard mitigation plan in Australia, integrating prevention and preparedness into government investment. It features place-based Disaster Adaptation Plans (DAPs), whole-of-government coordination, and explicit inclusion of Aboriginal advisory structures. The plan embeds natural hazard risk into NSW Treasury Business Case Guidelines and emphasizes evidence-based risk identification, funding alignment, and culturally informed governance.
